notes:
Mid-market ITSM vendor building internal helpdesk agent for enterprise customers and internal ops. Primary driver: reduce L1 ticket load and speed up internal IT responses for ~800 employees. Team is product-led; wants hosted API to move fast, then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and stricter network controls. Emphasis on streaming responses (progressive UX) and tool calling for actions (ticket creation, escalate to human, run diag scripts).

Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs with immutable traces, retention controls per policy (30/90/365 day buckets), and KMS integration. Data residency: EU tenant customers require EU-only residency for conversation logs.

Pricing sensitivity: mid-market procurement — prefers committed monthly with burst. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce token costs.

AE notes: "They care more about latency tail than average — need 95th percentile under 400ms for short messages." SE added: "demo must include streaming + function call flow (ticket create -> attach transcript -> confirm)."

use_case_summary: Internal IT/helpdesk chatbot for NorthPoint product and ops teams. Workload is primarily chat/agent with streaming first-token and partial response updates, plus tool calling for ticket creation, status checks, and runbook triggers. Throughput moderate (peak 120 concurrent agents), latency-sensitive: 95th percentile target < 400ms for sub-256 token responses. Needs audit trail per conversation and retention controls for compliance.
